༄༅/ /lha lnga'i sgrub thabs bde chen yang gsal sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /lha lnga'i sgrub thabs bde chen yang gsal sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs/

rgyal kun lhan skyes bde ba'i ye shes che/ /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*/ /bla ma he ru ka dang bcom ldan ma'i/ /zhabs la btud nas de yi sgrub thabs bshad/ /'dir bde mchog lha lnga'i sgrub thabs rgyas bsdus 'tshams pa zhig brjod par bya ste/ de yang bris sku dang mchod pa yo byad rnams tshogs par byas nas/ bla ma he ru ka dpal dang*/ /mchog gsum rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis byang chub sems bskyed do/ /zhes skyabs sems bya/ de nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis he ru ka sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud par gyur/ nang mchod byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro hi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa me 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du oṃ āḥhūṃ gsum las byung ba'i mi mgo rlon pa'i skyed pu la gnas pa'i a dkar po las byung ba'i thod pa dum bu gcig pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang gi shar du oṃ dkar po las byung ba'i dri chen oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ byang du khaṃ ljang khu las byung ba'i sha chen khaṃ gyis mtshan pa/ nub tu aṃ dmar po las byung ba'i byang sems aṃ gis mtshan pa/ lhor twaṃ ser po las byung ba'i rakta twaṃ gis mtshan pa/ dbus su hūṃ sngon po las byung ba'i dri chu hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ mer laṃ dkar po las byung ba'i ba glang gi sha laṃ gis mtshan pa/ bden bral du maṃ sngon po las byung ba'i khyi'i sha maṃ gyis mtshan pa/ rlung du baṃ dmar po las byung ba'i glang po che'i sha paṃ gyis mtshan pa/ dbang ldan du taṃ ljang khu las byung ba'i rta'i sha taṃ gis mtshan pa/

rlung g.yo ba las me 'bar ba'i drod kyis rdzas yi ge dang bcas pa rnams zhu nas nyi ma 'char ka'i mdog ltar dmar ser du gyur/ de'i steng du hūṃ dkar po las byung ba'i kha ṭaṃ ga dkar po byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can mgo bo thur du bltas pa thod par lhung ste zhu bas/ bcud de dag dngul chu'i mdog can bsil bar gyur/ oṃ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha kṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ yi ge de nyid kha dog sna tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i steng du gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ oṃ dkar po āḥdamar po hūṃ sngon po gsum steng nas steng du gnas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo'i dbang phyug ma rnams kyi thugs ka'i sa bon las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug pa oṃ āḥ hūṃ la thim/ de gsum yang rim gyis zhu nas thod par thim par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum/ 'dir rdzas dgu las mi 'byung ba ni/ sha chen gyis rdzas gnyis kyis go chod pa'i dbang du mdzad pa'o/ /byin rlabs bsdu na/ ha ho hrīḥ kha dog dri ro nus pa'i skyon thams cad bcom zhing bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum brjod pas kyang 'grub/ sngon 'gro'i mchod pa/ khaṇḍa ro his bsangs swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las kaṃ las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūṃ las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas rol mo rnams/ rang bzhin stong nyid/ rnam pa mchod rdzas so so'i rnam pa can/ byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can ster bar gyur/ oṃ ārghaṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ pā dyaṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badzra dhu pe āḥhūṃ/

oṃ badzra dī ba āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badzra nai wi te āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badzra shapta āḥhūṃ/ gtor ma yang nang mchod ltar byin brlab bya'o/ /de nas gzhung nas bshad pa ltar 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ pheṃ rang gi thugs kar nyi gdan la gnas pa'i hūṃ yig las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis/ dur khrod brgyad na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong dang zhing skyong la sogs pa thams cad spyan drangs te phyogs mtshams brgyad du 'khod pa skad cig gis 'od gsal du bcug pa las bde mchog gi lha yab yum gyi sku bzhengs pa'i mgron rnams kyi ljags hūṃ dkar po las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse gsum pa dkar po nas 'bru tsam 'khor ba'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus drangs nas gsol bar gyur/ oṃ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ sarba yakṣa rakṣas/ bhu ta/ pre ta/ pi sha tsa/ unmā da/ a pasmā ra/ badzra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ye da ya/ i maṃ ba li gṛ hna tu/ sa ma ya rakṣantu/ ma ma sarba siddhī mme pra ya tstshantu/ ya thai ba/ ya theṣta/ bhu dza tha/ pi pā tha/ dzi ghra tha/ ma ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kā rta ya/ sa ta su khaṃ/ bi shuddha ye/ sa ha yi ka/ bha wanta/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ lan gnyis kyis phyogs g.yon dang mtshams g.yas skor du gnas pa la 'bul/ oṃ arghaṃ pra ti tstsha swā hā/ oṃ bā dyaṃ pa titstsha swā hā/ oṃ badzra puṣpe/ de bzhin du/ dhu pe/ dī baṃ/ gandhe/ nai bi te/ shapta āḥhūṃ/ phyogs skyong dang zhing skyong la sogs pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /klu yi tshogs rnams la gnod sbyin= srin po'i= 'byung po'i= yi dwags= sha za'i= smyo byed= brjed byed= mkha' 'gro'i= ma mo'i= ma lus pa ni thams cad dag /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bstan pa bsrung dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir/ /thugs dam bcas shing zhal gyis 'ches pa rnams/ /dpal chen bka' sdod yid ltar mgyogs pa yi/ /'jigs po'i gzugs can drag gtum mi bzad pa/

/gdug pa 'dul mdzad nag po'i phyogs rnams 'joms/ /rnal 'byor las la 'bras bu ster mdzad cing*/ /mthu stobs byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /gnod sbyin tshogs sogs brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sde brgyad btsun mo sras dang g.yogs bcas pas/ /dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin bdag la stsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*/ /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*/ /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /srung mas rtag tu grogs mdzod cig /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*/ /gdon dang bgegs rnams zhi ba dang*/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ /'bru rnams rgyas shing chos 'phel dang*/ /bde legs thams cad 'byung ba dang*/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /yig brgya bzlas/ badzra muḥ 'jig rten pa rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ bdag bskyed kyi mchod pa sngon 'gro'i gtor ma'i skabs ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ yig brgya'i bzlas pa byed na/ gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar bya zhing*/ rgyun pa'i mngon rtogs la ni sngon 'gro'i mchod gtor yig brgya bzla ba'i skor rnams bzhag kyang 'gal ba med pas/ de ltar byed na/ nang mchod dang mchod pa byin brlabs byas pa'i 'phro nas skabs 'dir 'jug go /de nas dag pa gsum gyi rnal 'byor ni/ shrī he ru ka /he ni kun gyi 'byung gnas su gyur pa'i sems te rgyu'i bdag nyid du brtag par bya bas stong pa'i chos kyi bdag med pa dang*/ ru ni gang zag gi bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog gi dra bas bkod pa'i bdag dang bral ba'i gang zag gi bdag med pa dang*/ ka ni de kho na nyid kyi yul yul can gnyis mi mthun par so sor gnyis su mi gnas pa dang*/ shrī ni yul stong pa nyid ji 'dra ba de bzhin du rjes su zhugs pa'i gnyis su med pa'i ye shes e waṃ gi don

no/ /stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid skad cig gis he ru ka sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa la/ yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud par gyur/ shrī he ru ko3haṃ/ lan gsum brjod/ de nas mgo bor oṃ dang mthar hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa dang ldan pa'i ā li kā li lan gsum brjod nas/ rang gi lte ba'i phyogs su sngags 'phreng 'od zer dang bcas pa g.yon bskor du lan gsum bskor te gnas pa las/ lha lnga'i tshogs 'phros pa sna bug g.yas pa nas 'thon te phyogs bcur 'phros pas bgegs thams cad bskrad/ slar byon rang gi sna bug g.yon pa nas zhugs lte ba'i sngags phreng la thim par gyur/ de nas tshogs zhing ni/ rang he ru kar gnas pa'i thugs kar paṃ ser po las sna tshogs padma'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dpal mchog dang po'i yi ge hūṃ sngon po ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin can 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phro ba'i 'od zer gyis rang gi spyi bo nas rkang pa'i bar gang ste/ thog ma med pa nas kyi sgo gsum gyi dri ma rnams sbyangs pas lus shel gong bzhin du dag par gyur te/ ba spu'i sgo nas phyir 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis 'gro ba kun gyi lus sbyangs/ sgo gsum dag par byas/ sprin sgra'i yi ge'i 'od des bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa can dang*/ sngon nas grub pa'i 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang*/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ lha dang lha mo dang*/ khro bos nam mkha'i khams til gyi gang bu ltar gang ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen gnas/ /nas pad la 'dud/ /he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che/ / rnam dag rdo rje'i dbang phyug dang*/ /rjes chags chags pa che rnams kyi/ /rdo rje phag mo de la 'dud/ /dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/

/mkha' 'gro ma yis 'khor lo sgyur/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid/ /'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /kun tu rtogs pa'i 'ching gcod cing*/ / 'jig rten bya ba la 'jug ma/ /de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes phyag bya/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las byung ba'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhes pa nas shapta'i bar dang*/ oṃ āḥbadzra ā darshe hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadzra wi ṇe hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadzra gandhe hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadzra ra se hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadzrasparshe hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadzra dharme hūṃ/ zhes sbyar la mchod/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las byung ba'i snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhis thod pa'i nang gi bdud rtsi lngas mchod par gyur/ oṃ sarba badzra kā mi ni sarba bhakṣa sho dha ya gu hya ba dzri ni swā hā/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs te bde ba chen po bskyed pas lha thams cad kyi kyang bde ba chen po nyams su myong bar gyur/ dkon mchog gsum la nas 'grub par shog /sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa thams cad bsal ba'i phyir nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul lo/ /rgyal ba mya ngan las 'da' bar bzhed pa rnams 'gro ba kun la phan pa dang bde ba'i don du bskal ba zhing gi rdul snyed du bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs so/ /bgrod dka' srid pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /bdag gis 'gro rnams bsgral ba'i phyir/ /rang gi bdag nyid skad cig ma/ /sangs rgyas rnams la dbul bar bgyi/ /sems can thams cad khyad par du 'phags pa'i bde ba dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig /thob zin pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /nyon mongs pa dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig /com ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyis bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

/yig brgya tshar gcig brjod la/ tshogs zhing rnams 'od du gyur te rang gi smin mtshams nas zhugs pas byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ ces 'dzam bu gling pa'i sngags spyod pa'i rten gyi mi'i lus thob pa'i rgyur bsod nams kyi las 'du bya ba ltar bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags/ chos thams cad ngo bo nyid kyis grub pa med la kun rtog gis btags pa tsam gyi sgyu ma lta bur gyur/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ thugs ka'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis brtan g.yo thams cad sbyangs te 'od du gyur pa rang la thim zhing rang yang stod smad nas rim gyis thugs ka'i hūṃ la thim/ hūṃ gi ū ni ha'i lus la/ de mgo bo la/ de zla tshes la/ de thig le la/ de nā da la/ nā da yang 'od gsal du thim par gyur/ oṃ shu n+ya ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/ chos thams cad rab tu gnas pa med pa nam mkha' dri ma med pa'i 'od gsal du gyur/ de ni las bsags pa'i mthar 'chi ba 'od gsal sngon du byas pa dang chos mthun par bsgom pa 'chi ba chos skur 'khyer ba'i rnal 'byor/ de ltar snang ba thams cad bsdus pa'i stong pa'i ngang las rang gi sems nā da'i gzugs gyen du 'greng ba shin tu phra ba dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa nam mkhar gnas par gyur/ de ni 'chi ba 'od gsal las bar do grub pa dang chos mthun par bsgom pa longs sku'i lam 'khyer/ de nas bsrung 'khor ni/ oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ shar du sngags de nyid kha dog nag po/ oṃ gri hna gri hna hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ byang du sngags de nyid kha dog ljang khu/ oṃ gri nha pā ya gri hṇa pā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ nub tu sngags de nyid kha dog dmar po/ /oṃ ā na ya hoḥbha ga wā na bi dya rā dzā hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ lhor sngags de nyid kha dog ser po rnams 'khod par gyur/ sngags de rnams las rang rang gi kha dog can gyi 'od zer 'phros pas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas gser gyi sa gzhi la thug par khyab pa'i 'od zer 'bar ba'i gzugs chen pos khyab pa rnams su gyur/

sngags 'od zer dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ shar nag /byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i ra ba gru bzhi ba tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas gser gyi sa gzhi la thug gi bar du khyab par gyur/ ra ba grub pa dang dus mnyam du hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa'i hūṃ gi 'od zer las gser gyi sa gzhi la thug pa'i 'og gi sa gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i hūṃ gi 'od zer las phyi rol du steng dang logs kun tu khyab par rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i rnam pa can gyi mda'i dra ba dang*/ de'i 'og tu rdo rje'i gur/ gur gyi 'og ra ba'i steng du rdo rje'i bla re rnams bar mtshams med par dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi rol du rdo rje'i me 'jig dus kyi me lta bus bskor bar gyur/ oṃ me di nī badzri bha wa badzra bandha hūṃ/ oṃ dzra prā ka ra hūṃ paṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badzra bañtsar hūṃ paṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badzra bi tā na hūṃ khaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badzra sā ra dzwa la traṃ saṃ traṃ/ oṃ badzra dzwa la a na lwarka hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ suṃ bha ni sogs sngags bzhi sngar bzhin brjod nas/ rnam pa thams cad du 'gro ba rnams bgegs dang bral bar gyur/ bsrung 'khor gyi dbus su yaṃ sngon po las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu lta bu g.yas g.yon gnyis su rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ dmar po las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa grwa gsum du raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ dkar po las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du laṃ ser po las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi pa grwa bzhir rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du suṃ las ri rab lhun po gru bzhi pa rin po che sna bzhi'i rang bzhin can/ steng gi phyogs mtshams su lcog brgyad kyis mdzes pa/

de'i steng du paṃ ser po las sna tshogs padma/ de'i lte bar hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de'i lte bar paṃ las lte ba dang tshad mnyam pa'i sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang ge sar dang ldan pa/ phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma dmar/ me rlung gnyis ser/ bden bral ljang*/ dbang ldan nag /lte ba ljang*/ ge sar ser ba/ sna tshogs padma chung ngu'i dbus su mtshan so gnyis kyi ngo bo/ oṃ āḥ.i ī/ nas/ aṃ āḥ ste dbyangs dkar po bcu drug pa phrag gcig g.yas bskor dang*/ slar yang a ā/ nas aṃ aḥste dbyangs dkar po bcu drug pa phrag gcig g.yon bskor du rim pa gcig gis 'khod/ de'i phyi rol tu dpe byad brgyad cu'i ngo bo/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzña nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ya ra la la wa/ sha ṣa sa hakṣa ste gsal byed dmar po bzhi bcu pa phrag gcig g.yas bskor dang*/ slar yang ka kha nas kṣa ste gsal byed dmar po bzhi bcu pa phrag gcig g.yon bskor du rim pa gcig gis 'khod/ de gnyis yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can la dbyangs gsal rnams gzugs brnyan shar ba bzhin du snang ba'i ā li dang zla ba'i kha dog dkar ba'i cha ni me long lta bu'i ye shes/ kā li dang zla ba'i kha dog dmar ba'i cha ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ rang nam mkha'i nā das zla ba dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can mthong ba na bdag gis sangs rgyas yab yum gyi byang sems dkar dmar gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i dbus su skye ba blangs la sems can gyi don bya'o snyam pa'i 'phen pa dang ldan pas zla ba'i dbus su nā da zhugs pa las/ 'di ni bar do pha ma'i khu khrag gi dbus su skye ba blangs ba dang chos mthun pas te skye ba sbyong byed sprul sku'i lam 'khyer/ rim gyis nā da las thig le/ de las zla phyed/ de las ha'i mgo bo/ de las ha'i lus/ de las ū grub pa'i tshul gyis dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can gyi hūṃ yig rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rang bzhin can du rdzogs pa ni so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/

hūṃ las kha dog sna lnga pa'i 'od zer 'phro ba'i rtse mo las lha lnga'i lha tshogs rnams 'thon te 'gro ba rnams lha lnga'i go 'phang la bkod pa dang*/ sngon thog ma med pa nas grub pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i zhing khams na bzhugs pa rnams lhan cig spyan drangs pa dang mnyam par sbyar ba sngon du 'gro bas zhu nas hūṃ yig gi nā da la thim zhing*/ hūṃ yig lhan skyes kyi dga' ba'i rang bzhin can gyur pa ni/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ sarba bi ra yo gi nī kā ya wāka tsitta badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/ oṃ badzra shuddha sarba dharma badzra shuddho3haṃ/ zla ba dbyangs gsal hūṃ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur ba las/ rten dang brten pa'i dkyil thams cad dus gcig tu grub pa ni chos kyi dbyings ye shes/ de yang khang pa brtsegs pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i rin po che'i rtsig pas bskor ba'i steng na/ rin po che'i pha gu gzhi dmar po la rin po che zur gsum pa dang grub bzhi pa la sogs pas spras pa/ de'i steng na gnas pa'i gser gyi ske rags bzhi'i phyi ngos su chu srin gyi kha nas mu tig gi do shal dang*/ do shal phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'i phyir ngos su bya 'dab la 'phyang ba'i rin po che'i shar bu/ de'i steng du padma 'dab ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can gyi mda' yab la gnas pa'i gser gyi bum pa nas 'thon pa'i rgyal mtshan dang ba dan brgyad brgyad kyis mdzes par byas pa/ phyi'i steng gi zur bzhi la gdugs bzhis brgyan pa/ rtsig pa'i 'gram nas 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar pos bskor ba la bzhugs stabs dang kha dog sna tshogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa byed bzhin pa/ sgo dang sgo khyud kyi mtshams dang rtsig pa'i phyi nang gi zur bzhir zla phyed la gnas pa'i rin po che dmar po'i steng du rdo rjes brgyan pa/

sgo bzhi so so'i mdun du stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i steng du bum pa la gnas pa'i ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta babs snam bu bcu gcig dang ldan pa'i rtse mor chos kyi 'khor lo'i g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang bcas pa/ rta babs kyi g.yas g.yon du bum pa bzang po las skyes pa'i dpag bsam gyi shing la rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun dang*/ bar bar du grub pa thob pa dang*/ sprin gyi gseb nas byung ba'i lha mo me tog gi phreng ba bzung ba rnams kyis kun nas mdzes par byas pa/ de'i phyi rol du sna tshogs rdo rje'i ra bas bskor ba la sogs pa'i bsrung 'khor/ de'i phyi rol tu bskal pa 'jig dus kyi me lta bu'i kha dog sna lnga pa'i rdo rje'i me steng dang logs kun tu khyab par g.yon bskor du 'khyil zhing 'bar ba/ de'i phyi rol tu gtum drag la sogs pa'i dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du ka ba brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rdo rje'i gdung gis mdzes par phub pa'i rtse mor rdo rje nor bu rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ gzhal yas khang gi nang gi steng 'og rnams shar dkar/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser/ dbus sngo ba/ de'i dbus su sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ phyogs bzhi'i 'dab mar nyi ma dang ro'i gdan re re/ dbus kyi padma'i lte bar nyi ma'i gdan la/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sku mdog mthing kha zhal bzhi pa'i rtsa zhal nag /g.yon zhal ljang*/ rgyab zhal dmar/ g.yas zhal ser ba/ zhal re re yang spyan gsum pa/ phyag bcu gnyis pa/ dpral bar rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i 'phreng ba 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas 'jigs byed nag po lag pa bzhi pa'i dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas lhag ma ḍā ma ru/ g.yon lhag ma ral gri 'dzin pa'i mgo bo mnan pa/ g.yon bskums pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo lag pa bzhi pa'i dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/

lhag ma gnyis thod pa dang kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa'i nu ma mnan pa/ gdan gnyis ka'ang gdong gcig pa/ mig gsum pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyi rdo rje phag mo la 'khyud pa'i g.yas pas rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang g.yon pas dril bu 'dzin pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyi glang po che'i pags pa dkar po khrag dang bcas pa'i na bza' phyag g.yas pas lag pa g.yon pa dang*/ g.yon pas rkang pa g.yon pa'i lpags pa sdigs mdzub dang bcas te phyag gis brkyangs te 'dzin pa'i sdigs mdzub kyi rtse gnyis smin pa'i thad sor gnas pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍā ma ru/ bzhi pa na dgra sta/ lnga pa na gri gug drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa bsgreng ba/ g.yon pa'i phyag gsum pa na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ga /bzhi pa na khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ lnga pa na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa/ sna tshogs rdo rje mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thor cog can/ dbu re re la rdo rje nag po'i 'phreng ba stod smad du gnas pa gnyis la brgyus pa'i thod pa skam po lnga lngas brgyan pa/ dbu'i g.yon du zla ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/ mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs shing 'jigs su rung ba/ sgeg pa/ dpa' ba/ mi sdug pa ste/ sku'i nyams gsum dang*/ rgod pa/ drag shul/ 'jigs su rung ba ste gsung gi nyams gsum dang*/ snying rje dang*/ rngam pa dang*/ zhi ba ste thugs kyi nyams gsum ste nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ mi'i rgyu ma la brgyus pa'i mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu'i 'phreng ba 'phyang ba/ phyag rgya lngas rgyas btab pa/ mi rus kyi thal bas lus thams cad la byugs pa'o/ / bcom ldan 'das la mngon du phyogs par bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo/ zhal gcig ma phyag gnyis ma/ spyan gsum ma/ gcer mo skra grol ba/ thod pa'i dum bus brgyan pa'i 'og bag can/ phyag g.yon pas yab kyi mgul nas thod pa na bdud bzhi la sogs pa'i khrag gis gang ba bsnams shing*/

g.yas pas phyogs bcu'i gdug pa can kun la gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis bsdigs par mdzad pa/ 'jig dus kyi me ltar 'bar ba/ byin pa gnyis kyis yab kyi brla'i steng nas legs par 'khril ba/ bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin gyis thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i thod dang*/ mi mgo skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ phyogs bzhi'i gdan la/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu khaṇḍa ro hī dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig ma/ spyan gsum ma/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa'i zhal can/ gcer mo skra grol ba/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis gri gug dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ thod skam lnga bcu'i do shal can/ mtshams bzhir zla gdan la bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i steng du ka pā la byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba re re/ yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa las hūṃ dkar po las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/ byā dmar po las byung ba'i nor bu dmar po rtse mor byā ser pos mtshan pa/ yum gyi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa las āḥlas byung ba'i padma dmar po 'dab ma gsum pa/ byā dkar po las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems mtshon pa'i lte ba dkar po/ rtse mor dya ser pos mtshan pa/ yab kyi lte bar zla gdan la/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa na ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ thugs kar zla gdan la/ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā gi ni badzra warṇa nī ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ mgrin par nyi gdan la/ oṃ shrī badzra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ huṃ phaṭa/ ḍā ki ni dzwa la shaṃ bha raṃ swā hā/ dpral bar nyi gdan la/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ huṃ phaṭa/ yum gyi lte bar nyi gdan la/ oṃ shrī nas swā hā/ thugs kar nyi gdan la/

oṃ hrīḥnas phaṭa swā hā/ mgrin par zla gdan la/ oṃ badzra nas swā hā/ dpral bar zla gdan la/ oṃ sarba nas swā hā/ sngags thams cad kha dog dmar po 'od zer 'phro ba g.yon bskor du gnas pa/ sngags rnams kyang zhal sbyor ba phan tshun du 'khyud pa'i rnam pa can du gyur/ oṃ shrī ma hā su kha badzra he he ru ru kaṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ snyoms par zhugs pas/ byang sems spyi bo nas mgrin par sleb pa na dga' ba/ mgrin pa nas snying gar sleb pa na mchog dga'/ snying ga nas lte bar sleb pa na khyad par gyi dga' ba/ lte ba nas nor bu'i rtser sleb pa na lhan skyes kyi ye shes skyes pas rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis kyang bde stong dbyer med kyi ngo bor gyur cing*/ de ltar bde stong dbyer med du sbyar ba de nyid byang chub phyogs kyi chos kyi ngo bor gyur pa lha lngar shar ba na/ lus dran pa nye bar gzhag pa mkha' 'gro ma/ tshor ba dran pa nye bar gzhag pa lā ma/ chos dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dum skyes ma/ sems dran pa nye bar gzhag pa gzugs can ma/ yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni dpal he ru ka ste/ lha rnams snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan bzhin du gyur/ go cha'i lha rgyas pa bsgom pa'am nyung zhing lag tu blang bde bar 'dod na/ rang gi thugs kar zla ba la rdor sems kyi ngo bo oṃ ha dkar po/ mgo bor nyi ma la rnam snang gi ngo bo na ma hi ser po/ spyi gtsug tu nyi ma la padma gar dbang gi ngo bo swā hā hu dmar po/ phrag pa gnyis su nyi ma la dpal he ru ka'i ngo bo boṣta he nag po/ mig gnyis su nyi ma la rdo rje nyi ma'i ngo bo hūṃ hūṃ ho dmar ser/ dpral bar nyi ma la rta mchog gi ngo bo phaṭa haṃ ljang gu/ gtso mo'i lte bar nyi ma la rdo rje phag mo'i ngo bo oṃ baṃ dmar po/ snying gar nyi ma la gshin rje ma'i ngo bo haṃ oṃ sngon po/ mgrin par zla ba la rmongs byed ma'i ngo bo hriṃ moṃ dkar po/

mgo bor nyi ma la skyong byed ma'i ngo bo hriṃ hriṃ ser po/ spyi gtsug tu nyi ma la skrag byed ma'i ngo bo hūṃ hūṃ ljang gu/ dpral bar nyi ma la tsaṇḍi ga'i ngo bo phaṭa phaṭa dud kha rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ de nas ye shes pa spyan drang ba ni/ pheṃ rang gi thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ yig las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo'i dbang phyug ma'i ye shes pa'i 'khor lo dang*/ dbang gi lha mchod pa'i lha mo dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spya drangs/ 'od zer rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ la thim par gyur/ hūṃ oṃ arghaṃ pra titstsha hūṃ swā hā/ badzra aṃ gu sha dzaḥ badzra pā sha hūṃ/ badzra sphoṭa baṃ/ badzra ghaṇḍa hoḥ ye shes pa rnams dam tshig pa so so dang gnyis su med par gyur/ lha rnams kyi spyi bor zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par padmo la āḥdamar po/ thugs kar nyi ma la hūṃ sngon po/ oṃ yaṃ ga shuddha sarba dharma yo ga shuddho3haṃ/ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis ro mnyam du sbyar ba ni chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid dang*/ bde ba chen po'i ye shes gnyis ngo bo dbyer med yin la/ de nyid rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du shar ba yin cing*/ de yang gtso bo yab yum du shar ba'i cha shas so/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ sarba bi ra yo gi ni nas badzra shuddho3haṃ/ oṃ arghaṃ pra titstsha swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyis bgegs bskrad/ dpa' bo rnams kyis shis pa brjod/ dpa' mo rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ gtso bos dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ yum bzhi phag mo dang bcas pas rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzung nas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pas khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/

/de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas/ rang dang lha rnams bde ba chen po'i bdag nyid du gyur pa'i spyi bo nas sku la zhugs pa'i chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ gtso bo la rdo rje sems dpa'/ phag mo la mi bskyod pa/ mkha' 'gro ma la rnam snang*/ lā ma la don grub/ dum skyes ma la 'od dpag med/ gzugs can ma la rin 'byung gis dbu brgyan te/ dbang gi lha rnams rang la thim par gyur/ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ spyan drangs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsams la/ oṃ arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ bā dyaṃ/ añtsa ma ṇaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūṃ swā hā/ nas shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ āḥbadzra ā darshe hūṃ/ nas/ dharme hūṃ/ gi bar sngar bzhin rig ma drug gis mchod/ rig ma bcu drug sogs mchod pa rgyas bar byas kyang rung la/ nang mchod ni/ bla brgyud rgyas pa ltar ram/ bsdu na/ mchod do skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gi zhal du= rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i= grub chen dril bu ba'i= chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po'i= mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i= rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang brtson 'grus pa'i= gzhan yang dbang bskur rgyud bshad man ngag bstan pa'i bla ma dam pa brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i zhal du= oṃ hrīḥnas hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra bai ro nas phaṭa swā hā= oṃ ḍā ki ni nas rū pi ṇi ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa= gzhan yang rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi= sngon sangs rgyas mthong ba/ dam pa'i chos thos pa/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la brten pa/ bstan pa dang 'khor rnam bzhi skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyis bsten cing bsgrubs pa'i bsrung ma dam tshig can rnams kyi/

yul sum cu so gnyis/ gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ dur khrod chen po brgyad na gnas pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma/ phyogs skyong dang zhing skyong dang klu la sogs pa rnams kyi= gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa dang sems thams cad lhar gyur pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ a mṛ ta swa da na badzra swa bha wa atma ko3haṃ/ mgron rnams ye shes kyi bdud rtsis mnyes par gyur/ oṃ sarba badzra kā mi ni gu hya badzri ni swā hā/ oṃ shrī ma hā su kha badzra he he ru ru kaṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ gnas bzhi dang gsang gnas byin gyis brlabs te/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas byang sems zhu ba skye bo nas mgrin par sleb pa na dga' ba nas nor bu rtser sleb pa na lhan skyes kyi ye shes skyes pas lha thams cad kyis kyang bde ba chen po nyams su myong bar gyur/ dkyil 'khor pa'i lha rnams lhan skyes kyi bde ba dang*/ stong pa nyid dbyer med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pas de kho na nyid kyi mchod pas mnyes par gyur/ de nas sngags mchod na/ oṃ shrī badzra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ huṃ phaṭa/ ḍā ki nī dzwa la shaṃ bha raṃ swā hā/ yab kyi snying po'o oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ huṃ phaṭa/ nye snying ngo*/ /oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nā ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ yum gyi snying po'o/ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā kī nī ye badzra warṇa ni ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ nye snying ngo*/ oṃ ḍā kīnṭaṃ/ ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ lā me huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro hī huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rū bi ṇi huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces sogs snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i sngags so/ /bstod pa ni/ oṃ bcom ldan dpa' bo'i dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ bskal pa chen po'i me dang mnyam pa'i 'od= ral pa'i cod paṇa mi bzad pa dang ldan= mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa 'jigs pa'i zhal= stong phrag phyag ni 'bar ba'i 'od zer can=

dgra sta zhags gdengs mdung dang kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin= stag gis pags pa'i na bza' 'dzin pa can= sku chen dud kha bgegs mthar mdzad la 'dud/ rnams la huṃ hūṃ phaṭa sbyar ba dang*/ yum la'ang oṃ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal/ 'phags ma rig ma'i dbang phyug khams gsum gyis mi thub/ 'byung po'i 'jigs pa thams cad rdo rje chen pos 'joms/ rdo rje'i gdan bzhugs gzhan gyi mi thub dbang byed spyan/ gtum mo khro mo'i gzugs kyis tshangs pa skem par mdzad/ bdud rnams skrag cing skem byed gzhan gyi phyogs las rgyal/ rmugs byed rengs byed rmongs byed kun las rnam par rgyal/ rdo rje phag mo sbyor chen 'dod dbang ma la 'dud/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa sbyar ba'i rkang brgyad kyis bstod pa'am/ yang na/ he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che/ /zhes sogs sngar bzhin bstod/ de nas bzlas pa ni/ bgrang 'phreng bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bgrang 'phreng gsung rdo rje padma gar dbang dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis padma dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis dril bu dang thod pa dang bcas pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin par gyur pa'i spyi bor oṃ mgrin par āḥthugs kar hūṃ/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ arghaṃ pra titstsha ye swā hā/ de bzhin du pādyaṃ dang*/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūṃ swā hā/ de bzhin du shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ sngags kyi mthar oṃ āḥhūṃ sbyar la nang mchod phul/ oṃ swā hā hu huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ nyer gcig bzlas/ padma gar dbang 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bgrang 'phreng du gyur/ ces brjod/ lha rang rang gi thugs kar nyi gdan la gnas pa'i hūṃ yig gi mthar bzlas bya'i sngags kyis bskor ba las dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs spros/ 'gro ba'i don byas slar 'dus te hūṃ yig la thim pa'i spro ba dang bsdu ba'i mdzad pa can du gyur par bsams la/

yab yum gyi snying po dang nye snying*/ lha mo bzhi'i sngags sngar bshad pa rnams bzla/ bzlas pa'i tshe lha thams cad kyi zhal nas sngags kyi sgra 'byung bar mos par bya'o/ /bzlas pa'i mthar gtor ma bya ba'i tshul ni/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma phyag len ltar bshams/ nang mchod ltar bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs/ pheṃ rang gi thugs kar nyi gdan la gnas pa'i hūṃ yig las 'phros pa'i 'od zer phyis/ dur khrod brgyad na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong dang zhing skyong la sogs pas bskor ba'i 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mos mchod/ lha rnams kyi sngags hūṃ dkar po las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse gsum pa dkar po nas 'bru tsam 'khod pa'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus drangs nas gsol bar gyur pa bsams la/ oṃ badzra a ra li hoḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ badzra ḍā ki n+ya sa ma ya st+waṃ dri shya hoḥ tshar gcig gis gtso bo/ gnyis pas yum/ gsum pas rnal 'byor ma bzhi la 'bul/ sngar ltar chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa dang*/ yab kyi nye snying dang*/ yum gyi snying po dang*/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i sngags kyi mthar oṃ āḥhūṃ btags la nang mchod 'bul/ de nas sngar bzhin bstod pa'i 'phror/ srid pa dang mnyam zhi ba'i chags bcom kun tu rtog pa 'joms/ khyod ni dngos po mtha' dag mkha' ltar gzigs pa dang ldan pa/ /mgon po shin tu brtse ba lci ba'i chus brlan thugs kyi chus/ /mdzod cig lha mo rnams kyis bdag la shin tu rjes brtser mdzod/ /ces 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ de nas dur khrod brgyad na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong dang zhing skyong la sogs pa nas gsol bar gyur/ zhes dang*/ oṃ kha kha nas yig brgya'i bar sngon 'gro gtor ma'i skabs ltar la/ yig brgya'i mthar/ oṃ yo ga shuddha sarba dharmā yo ga shuddho3haṃ/ oṃ badzra muḥ

'jig rten pa rnams ngang gnas su gshegs shing*/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams bdag nyid la thim par gyur/ de nas nyer bsdu bya ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams snang bar byas te/ 'od du gyur ba'i bsrung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa gzhal yas khang la thim/ mtshams kyi bum pa thod pa dang bzhi snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi la/ de bzhi yang gtso bo'i zhal bzhi la thim/ gzhal yas khang gtso bo yab yum la/ gtso bo yab yum yang thugs ka'i hūṃ yig la thim/ hūṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las/ he ru ka sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa yum dang bcas par gyur pa'i thugs kar zla ba la rdor sems gyi ngo bo oṃ ha dkar po/ nas/ phaṭa phaṭa dud kha rnams kyi mtshan par gyur/ de nas oṃ sumbha sogs zhal bzhi pa'i sngags brjod de/ srid pa gsum 'bar sku ni rjes chags dul bar ldan/ 'od zer sngon po stong ldan nyi ma brgya stong ldan/ /rnam mang sku dang cha lugs rjes chags sems par ldan/ /he ru ka dpal de dang lhan cig gar byed shog /lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*/ /des brjod gsung yang mchog tu tshad ma ste/ /bden pa 'di dag gis ni lha mo rnams/ /bdag cag rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig / sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag ni he ru kar gyur nas/ /sems can thams cad he ru'i/ /go 'phang mchog la 'god par shog /ces bkra shis dang smon lam bya zhing*/ kha zas la 'jug pa na/ kha zas kyi skyed chog dang*/ 'bul tshul rgyas par 'grub na legs shing*/ ma grub na/ ha ho hriḥsogs brjod la snying ga'i hūṃ yig lha lnga 'dus pa'i bdag nyid du bsams la/ de la mchod pas bde ba chen pos mnyam par bsam zhing nang gi sbyin sreg gi tshul du longs spyod/ thun mtshams kyi spyod lam kun tu yang lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral bar bya'o/

/nyal ba'i tshe sngar gyi nyer bsdu'i dmigs pa ltar la/ hūṃ gi ū ni ha la/ ha'i lus mgo bo la/ de zla tshes la/ de thig le la/ de nā da la/ nā da yang mi dmigs par gyur par bsams la nyal zhing*/ ldang ba'i tshe snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhis glus bskul bar mos nas/ he ru ka yab yum gyi skur ldang ba dang*/ khrus kyi tshe dbang bskur rgyas btab kyi skabs kyi dmigs pa ltar lha mo rnams kyis rang la khrus gsol bar mos par bya'o/ /smras pa/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug grub chen dril bu pa'i/ /bzhed srol ji bzhin bde mchog lha lnga yi/ /rim pa dang po'i nyams len 'khyer bde zhig /dad ldan gzhan la phan srid snyam nas bris/ /de las thob pa'i legs tshogs ci mchis pas/ /'di dang phyi ma'i tshe rabs kun tu bdag /he ru ka dang rje btsun rnal 'byor mas/ /dgyes bzhin 'bral med rjes su 'dzin gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis 'dir lha lnga'i sgrub thabs la rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho dang*/ paṇa chen gong mas mdzad pa gnyis snang ba las/ snga ma'i bzhed pa gzhir byas na'ang de las cung bsdus shing*/ phyi ma'i dgongs pa kha bskang ba'i sgo nas rgyas bsdus 'tsham par co ne dgon nyid du sbyar ba'o/ /'dis kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ bha wantu// //
